parsed.notes:
The Ideal Candidate and Basic Qualifications default to required; Preferred Qualifications defaults to nice_to_have. Responsibilities and company descriptions do not independently establish skill requirements.
Seniority is inferred from explicit mentoring duty, not the numeric title or the levels of the people being mentored.
The highest degree named is master's; the bachelor's pathway is not an experience-only alternative.
The overlapping programming-language lists are collapsed by retaining the basic-qualification alternatives in group 1; group 3 contains the two additional preferred alternatives. The guide does not explicitly specify representation of overlapping alternative sets.
Similarity Search is tentatively mapped to vector-search because it is paired with VectorDBs; Memory is tentatively mapped to agent-state-management. Both mappings need review.
Online inference is tentatively treated as model serving rather than adding an inference skill absent from the taxonomy.
The wording producibility and automated retaining schedules is preserved literally, without correcting presumed typographical errors.
